_review: T046 draft. English is final; Tamil needs native review.
channelManager.sandbox: Sandbox: scripted reservations, nothing is sent to a real channel manager. Use the sandbox token shown in the connector guide.
ical.sandbox: No sandbox: iCal feeds are read-only. Paste a calendar link and the dates appear as bookings within 30 minutes.
feedFailing_title: A calendar link has stopped working
feedFailing_body: {label}: {reason}. Check the link in Integrations, then run Test connection.
reason_http_401: the calendar requires a sign-in (the link may have been regenerated)
reason_http_403: the calendar refused access (the link may have been regenerated)
reason_http_404: the calendar link no longer exists
reason_not_ical: the link did not return a calendar
reason_empty_feed: the calendar suddenly shows no dates at all
reason_timeout: the calendar did not answer in time
reason_too_large: the calendar is too large to read
reason_blocked_address: the link points to a private address
reason_other: the calendar could not be read
